facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Jack was poor. He had a cow. Mother was sad. Jack went to the market.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Jack was a poor boy. He lived with his mother. They had one old cow. Mother asked Jack to go out. Jack went to the market.
